title: Concept: pip hash checking switched off
description: pip.conf declares a `require-hashes=false` installer setting, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `require-hashes=false` installer setting.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pip.conf (pypi).
risk: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `require-hashes=false` installer setting.
